paper_title: Operation of a ferromagnetic axion haloscope at $m_a=58\,μ$eV
notes: Ferromagnetic axion haloscope (QUAX prototype). Upper limit g_aee < 4.9e-10 at 95% C.L. for m_a = 58 ueV (14 GHz, ~14.061 GHz f+ hybrid mode). Limit spans a small ~3 MHz range around 14 GHz; only the quoted minimum value at 58 ueV is explicitly given in text.
